title: keteleeria davidiana subsp. chien-peii
intro: Keteleeria davidiana subsp. chien-peii, commonly known as Chien Pei Fir, is a subspecies of coniferous tree in the family Pinaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Keteleeria davidiana subsp. chien-peii may include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, which could be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
